sources.title: Optimizing Inference for Long Context and Large Batch Sizes with NVFP4 ...
sources.snippet: NVFP4 KV cache quantization cuts memory footprint by up to 50% compared to FP8, effectively doubling context budgets for larger batch sizes, longer sequences, and higher cache-hit rates. The technique achieves these gains with less than 1% accuracy loss across code-generation, knowledge, and long-context benchmarks including LiveCodeBench, MMLU-PRO, MBPP, and Ruler 64K.
